item.title: A Multiversal Joyride
item.content:encoded:
http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/wolfmandeth

Here's my complete SCP article for the SCP-5144 place. Read the "First Contact" addendum and if you are still interested keep on reading. If you feel I need to change anything or make some parts more professional please tell me. Note that during the interviews, the entities do not speak that professional, however the scientists try to.
